plugins.name: debrief
plugins.description: Local TTS-only companion via MCP speak for Claude Code, Codex, and Grok on Apple Silicon.
plugins.installation: Build, then run debrief install (or --claude). Restart the host so MCP tool speak appears. Use skill debrief-speak at turn end.
plugins.privacy: Speaks only agent-provided text through the local headless daemon. No STT or cloud summarization.
